scope: Linux source Node; three alternating fresh process pairs per actual Git index. Index construction is outside measured children. Paths are tracked index entries absent from the worktree. Both modes drain all bytes; this does not reduce Git work or network traffic. Worker maxRSS is an OS high-water mark; process-tree PSS samples include live descendants when observed but are non-atomic and may miss short-lived peaks. Diagnostic GC only before/after timed work; natural GC events within the timed interval are recorded separately. No Electron renderer, model/VRAM, physical cold-cache, native Windows/macOS or live SSH-network performance claim.
